title: Ranking Stocks Daily with AI
author: hintheman
selftext:
# How it ranks

* **Slope analysis** against the S&P (relative trend strength).
* **RSI / CCI** trend staging and mean-reversion detection.
* **Triple-timeframe scan** (30m / 1h / 4h) for multi-timeframe confirmation.
* **EMA crossovers** (8 / 21 / 50 / 200) for trend structure.
* **ADX** for momentum quality.
* **IV percentile** — true percentile-of-history, not min-max IV Rank.

Price and average volume are the only hard universe filters. **PE and PEG are display-only** — shown per stock for your own fundamental read, but they do not feed the composite score or decide which names make the universe (a genuine trend/momentum leader often carries a "bad" PEG by design).

It produces 4 tables of stocks in four categories  

* Leading Stocks
* Mid-Caps Movers
* Reversion undervalued stocks
* Growth & Income stocks

In the DB, it keeps a universe of stocks in S&P and Nasdaq currently 513 de-duped.  And any click on a stock symbol will have TA.FA.Ranking details. The ranking can be retrieved given a date range such as latest two weeks. The chart is built with TradingView Embedded Widget.  And all the trends, slopes, EMA, Triple Screening on three timeframes and fundamentals are captured. 

I have 10 paper trading bots that runs mostly on the Leaders and Mid-Cap Movers.  I tried it on Growth & Income using wheeling strategy and it doesn't perform as well as the Leading stocks.  

It is free and open to everyone in this link [https://tickersrank.com/leaders](https://tickersrank.com/leaders)
